text:
maya (PM): Drafting a compact post-launch "stabilize lane" for days 0-7. Need clear guardrails: what gets an immediate hotfix vs scheduled fix, and who owns triage slots. Quick reactions please.

liam (ENG): love the idea. propose two daily triage windows (11:00 & 17:00) and an emergency page for real outages.

emma (Support): we need a tiny support template so we stop sending freeform notes. Suggest: Steps, Impact (users affected), App version, and screenshot.

raju (SRE): severity buckets suggestion:
- Sev-Crit: infra down, data loss -> page, hotpatch now
- Sev-High: core flow broken for multiple customers -> aim 48h fix, canary if possible
- Sev-Med: degraded with workaround -> schedule in next batch
- Sev-Low: enhancement/UX polish -> backlog

noa (Design): for UI regressions mark "core-path" if it affects signup, wallet, or billing. Require at least one screenshot + minimal repro for S-H.

sam (ProdOps): rollout rules:
- Sev-Crit: immediate rollback or emergency deploy; postmortem if >30min
- Sev-High: canary 5% for 20m, then ramp if OK
- Sev-Med: grouped weekly deploy

liam (ENG): process notes for fast fixes:
- label: stabilize:crit|high|med|low and customer:ID if relevant
- add traces or logs, minimal repro, owner, and ETA
- fastlane review: 2 reviewers in 6 hours for high/crit

maya (PM): acceptance rule to reclassify bug->enhancement: must have clear workaround, <=0.5% DAU affected, no data integrity risk, and no SLA hit.

emma (Support): I'll start using the template and can flag tickets into the stabilize lane automatically with a keyword match.

raju (SRE): add alert triggers: error spike >2x baseline for 10m, latency 95p > SLA for 15m, or 3 distinct customers report same failure in 12h -> auto-create stabilize:high.

sam (ProdOps): I'll wire alert-bot to create a draft issue and add initial labels.

liam (ENG): tiny automation idea for labels (pseudo):
# pseudo
create_issue --title "Auto: <short>" --label stabilize:high --body @support-template

maya (PM): action items:
- sam: configure stabilize board and hook alert-bot (today)
- liam: publish fastlane reviewer checklist (tomorrow)
- raju: push alert rules into monitoring (today)
- noa: share UI repro checklist and tiny patch guidance (EOD)
- emma: start using ticket template immediately

alert-bot: Created rule STB-3 (error-spike) and linked to oncall rota.

maya (PM): if no objections, we'll run a 12-min walkthrough in daily at 12:10 and start the stabilize lane at launch. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
